description: Currency conversion with official ECB euro reference rates (30 fiat currencies). Converts an amount between USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, CHF, CNY, INR, BRL, CAD, AUD and the other currencies the European Central Bank publishes daily (cross rates via EUR). Returns the rate, its date and source. Reference rates, not trading quotes. Price: $0.005 USDC per call via x402 (eip155:8453).
